We got lost in the big department store.
items.exampleZh: 我們在那間大百貨公司裡迷路了。

items.exampleEn: There is a grocery store under our apartment.
items.exampleZh: 我們公寓樓下有一家雜貨店。

items.exampleEn: She works as a shop assistant on weekends.

items.sentenceZh: 這件毛衣我是半價買的。

items.audioEn: The grocery store closes at ten, so let's go now.
items.audioZh: 雜貨店十點關門，我們現在就去吧。

items.sentenceEn: Ask the shop assistant for help.
The department store is on the corner.

items.stemEn: The ____ helped me find the right size.
items.stemZh: 店員幫我找到了合適的尺寸。

items.passageEn: Emma lives in London. Last Saturday, the department store near her home had a big sale. Everything was half-price! Emma bought a sweater and some shoes. A kind shop assistant helped her find the right size. On her way home, she stopped at a grocery store and bought some milk for ninety pence.
items.passageZh: Emma 住在倫敦。上週六，她家附近的百貨公司辦大特價，所有東西都半價！Emma 買了一件毛衣和幾雙鞋。一位親切的店員幫她找到合適的尺寸。回家路上，她順道去了雜貨店，花九十便士買了一些牛奶。

questions.questionZh: 百貨公司上週六有什麼活動？
options: 免費送每位客人一杯咖啡
新店開幕，送每人小禮物

questions.questionZh: Emma 回家路上買了什麼？

referenceEn: I only have a few cents in my pocket.
There are only a few cents in my pocket.
rubricZh: 「只有幾⋯」可寫例如 only a few

items.instructionZh: 用 grocery store 造一個句子，說說你常去的雜貨店，或你在那裡買什麼。
referenceEn: I buy fruit at the grocery store near my home.
The grocery store on my street is open until midnight.
rubricZh: grocery store 是可數名詞（例如 the grocery store、a grocery store）
「在雜貨店買」可用 at（例如 at the grocery store）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：「這顆糖果要五十分錢」：「分錢」不是台灣用語（台灣說「美分」或直接用「元」），題目中文不自然；建議改「這顆糖果要五十美分」，評分要點也一併調整
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "我口袋裡只剩幾美分。"（原 "這顆糖果要五十分錢。"）；「分錢」改台灣說法「美分」；同時依第③關 FIX 換掉和 pence 單字卡雷同的「X costs fifty …」情境

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：參考答案同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["I only have a few cents in my pocket.","There are only a few cents in my pocket."]（原 ["This candy costs fifty cents.","This candy is fifty cents."]）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：評分要點同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["「美分」用 cents（複數）","「只有幾⋯」可寫例如 only a few"]（原 ["「分錢」用 cents（複數）","「要⋯錢」可寫例如 costs、is"]）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：「一美元等於一百分」：原文 One dollar 未指明美元，「美元」屬補充，可接受但嚴格說不忠實；若保留「美元」，「一百分」宜作「一百美分」以免與分數混淆
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "一美元等於一百美分。"（原 "一美元等於一百分。"）；「一百分」改「一百美分」，避免與分數混淆
